english.note: Use this when “inherently” specifically means innate or present from birth.
Use this when the intrinsic quality is innate or present from birth, rather than simply belonging to the thing itself.
Use this for an inherent quality or tendency that someone has from birth, rather than for a manner of acting or “of course.”

examples.english: They are inherently shy around strangers and always hide when they meet someone new.
examples.traditional: 佢天生就怕生，見到陌生人總係匿埋。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 tin1 saang1 zau6 paa3 saang1 gin3 dou2 mak6 sang1 jan4 zung2 hai6 nei1 maai4
keoi5 tin1 saang1 zau6 hou2 jau5 jam1 ngok6 gam2

examples.english: I am naturally shy and don't know what to say when I meet strangers.
examples.traditional: 我天生怕醜，見到陌生人就唔識講嘢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tin1 saang1 paa3 cau2 gin3 dou2 maak6 saang1 jan4 zau6 m4 sik1 gong2 je5
